requirement: Across the flight envelope, and given the flight regimes to be determined during integration testing, the propulsion system shall also sustain a thrust-to-weight ratio of at least 1.5, drawing on six rotors, four wing-mounted and two tail-mounted, to generate a maximum thrust of 15 across hover, transition, and cruise flight. The propulsion system shall not reduce total thrust output when transitioning between flight regimes.

instances.explanation: 'the flight envelope' can be read as this aircraft's specific certified performance boundary (a token) or as the general engineering concept of a flight envelope (a type/class), leaving which one governs the 1.5 ratio unclear.

'also' presupposes some other thrust-to-weight obligation established elsewhere that this record is adding to, but no such prior obligation is identified in this text, so what is being supplemented is ambiguous.
the value 15 is stated with no unit (kgf vs. N vs. lbf), so the actual force magnitude is not verifiable from the text alone.
it is unclear whether 'not reduce' forbids any instantaneous thrust dip at all during the transition, or only forbids a lower net/average thrust between the start and end states of the transition.
the specific flight regimes this envelope requirement must cover are deferred to a to-be-determined list rather than enumerated, leaving the scope of 'flight envelope' incomplete.
